In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], agents of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] fomented a '''riot''' in the area of [[Merchant's Square]] in the [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] city of [[Drev'starn]], playing off civil unrest caused by the [[Caamas Document Crisis]]. After a large crowd gathered in the square, Imperial agents fired several [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] shots, which ignited a panic which drove the crowd into the nearby [[Combined Clans Center Building]]. [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] guards responded by firing shots into the mob, which was only prevented access to the building's upper floors through the efforts of famed [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] hero [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. In the chaos, twenty-seven rioters lost their lives, and about forty more were injured.

Among the casualties were two unarmed [[Leresai|Leresen]], whose people retaliated by sending a task force to destroy a small space station in orbit over Bothawui, killing twenty-one innocent Bothans (according to their own laws, twenty innocent lives were an acceptable proxy for two guilty persons of the same "tribe"). This spurred the [[Mon Calamari]] and [[Diamal]]an governments to send task forces to protect Bothawui from further aggression, precipitating the build-up of warships in orbit that eventually sparked the [[Battle of Bothawui (Galactic Civil War)|second Battle of Bothawui]].
